'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a male NPC noble of [[Capitoline Hill City]], looking to rise ranks. However, his evaluation of Gladiators capability is questionable.
{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle== 
:;'''Deximus:''' When will these Gladiators learn some appreciation? I've said I'd give them bonuses if they get the championship. Why can't they just put more effort into it...?
:;'''Deximus:''' Sigh. I came all this way.

==Dialogue==
:'''Deximus:''' Have a look at these Gladiators I've hired. This one can burst open ten boxes of Seasalt Popcorns with her bare hands, and that one can stomp ten bags of [[Bamboo Iris Crisps]].
:'''Deximus:''' Each is a one-of-a-kind talent. Pretty impressive, don't you think?
:{{DIcon}} Very impressive.
::'''Deximus:''' My thoughts as well. I hired these Gladiators myself. Of course, they're impressive.
::'''Deximus:''' As long as my Gladiators stand out in the arena, I'll have the chance to move up in the ranks.
:{{DIcon}} Seems all right.
::'''Deximus:''' You think so? But I shelled out big money for these Gladiators.
:{{DIcon}} Nothing compared to me.
::'''Deximus:''' So you think you're better than all of them? Then come be my Gladiator.
{{Dialogue End}}
